stories.title: Two, killed, two wounded in US strike on Iran’s Larak island — agency
stories.summary: TEHRAN, August 30. At least two people died and two others were wounded after a US drone attack on the Iranian island of Larak, the Tasnim news agency reported. According to the agency, the attack was carried out about an hour ago. No official comments are available at the moment. Axios and Israel’s Channel 12 correspondent. Barak Ravid said earlier that US forces had struck two missile launchers on the island of Larak in southern Iran.
